summary: Resolves both ends of a connected socket into a two-entry sockaddr array. Initializes the address-length variable to 16, calls getpeername to fill name[0] with the peer address, then calls getsockname to fill name[1] with the local address. Returns true only when both calls succeed (each returning 0).

operations.description: Initialize the address-length variable to 16 (bytes, the size of a sockaddr).
Call getpeername(socket s, name, &namelen) and record whether it returned 0 (success).
Call getsockname(socket s, name + 1, &namelen) to resolve the local address into the second sockaddr slot.
Return true only when getsockname returned 0 and the earlier getpeername call also returned 0.

unresolved: The owning class of the socket and the caller's use of the resolved peer/local addresses in sub_57CB50 are not evidenced by the packet.
Whether the two-entry sockaddr array lives in the caller's buffer and whether the returned addresses feed connection identification are not established here.
